market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$79k May 4, would need ~5% drop to dip to $75k in ~27 days. Recent strong momentum (+17% past month) makes near-term pullback less likely, but 5% drawdowns are common in any 4-week window. Estimate ~35%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or Iran escalation could trigger fast 5% pullback
